balls.text: he has done it with a six! McCullum, you beauty! Just picks that off the pads for his 14th six, this one over wide long-on, to finish on 158 not-out ... Kolkata post a massive 22 for 3 to boot .. McCullum remains there all innings
full in the zone, he drives past mid-on for two more, excellent running
slower ball just outside off, he misses and its a dot ball
full on the stumps, he walks across and clips two to get to 150 ... legend!
and thats lucky Number 13! Another pull for six, thats sailing away
going, going, gone! McCullum pulls a full toss over midwicket
now Hafeez gets going, paddling the last ball into the gap
full on the stumps and he pushes to mid-on
flashes at this, losing a hand off the bat, but Noffke misfields on the rope
he's hit that one to Mysore! Incredible! Walks down and tonks this over long-on for six and the crowd goes berzerk
misses out on this one, swinging wildly
he is not done! Kallis bowls a full toss and McCullum pulls over mid-on for another flat, flat six ... this is the second-highest Twenty20 score ever
full and he drives into the covers to keep hold of the strike
insane! McCullum gets cheeky, walking across in another attempt to paddle it down to fine leg but gets inside the line and top-edges over Boucher
biffed down over McCullum's head, not timed but its a run
nips back in off a length and Hafeez hops, playing it back to Noffke
low full toss is driven to mid-off for a single
and he strikes! Hussey goes for a big hit, slashing the ball up in the air and the spiraling top-edge is well held by White, running backward from point
holds back the length, McCullum opens the face and runs to third man
gets forward and drives a couple out to deep cover
friends, we are watching a Twenty20 genius at work! Thats a paddle from off and middle down to fine leg for a six! Just over the ropes and now Shah Rukh Khan is dancing
exposes the stumps and again and just gets bat on it, driving to cover
makes room and drives inside-out over extra cover, the ball lands safely and Praveen pulls off another top-class effort, reaching out with his left-hand and denying Hussey a four
walks across and clips the full one out to deep midwicket
full on the stumps, he exposes them all and steers to backward point
fired in full, he backs away and drives to mid-off for a single
swing and a miss to a shorter one outside off stump
and there it is! The first hundred of the IPL and a fabulous innings from McCullum! He drives the full delivery into the covers and celebrates, and what a cheer from the ground, and Shah Rukh Khan
full on the stumps, he on-drives down the ground for one
slower ball goes past his outside-edge as he skips down and misses
nervous 90s, whats that? McCullum pulls this one miles over midwicket
tighter delivery, Hussey farms the strike over with a push to midwicket
this one slants well down leg stump and Boucher fumbles
and again, skips down and hammers this down to long-off
thats outta here! McCullum skips down, giving himself room, and slams him over deep midwicket for another dinger
better delivery, Hussey punches to mid-on for a single
thats a seam-up delivery down leg and his Victorian team-mate helps it along its way down to fine leg, poor start

gets down and heaves past square leg again, timing it terribly, but the fast outfield speeds it out to the deep and a superb dive from Praveen on the ropes saves two ... its referred for a while and the verdict is that its safe
flights it up and Hussey comfortably drives down to long-off again
well bowled by Joshi, firing it into the blockhole, just one to mid-off
and he's off the mark with a drive down to long-off, using his feet
good flight, spins away and Hussey punches to cover
good length on off stump, he pushes to cover for one
full and flat outside off, he reaches out and slaps out to deep cover
he's enjoying this, just shuffling around his crease to get Kallis dropping short down leg stump and the ball is escorted to deep backward square
errs in line, too far down leg, McCullum misses the pull shot
flashed, and well fielded! McCullum gives Kallis the kitchen sink but Kohli dives excellently to his right at point to take pace off the ball and keep him to two
better ball, holding back the length and getting him pushing to point
slower delivery down leg, McCullum shuffles and turns it superbly down to fine leg, past the fielder, for four more
gone! Ponting tries to go downtown, but instead mistimes it up into the starry night and Praveen sits under it at mid-off to send him on his way
reaches out and paddles it past square leg out to the sweeper
uses his feet, Joshi beats him in the air and collects the ball
fuller, flatter, and he gets an inside-edge past midwicket
bowls it flat on leg, McCullum shuffles and clips to fine leg
woof! Thats clubbed, another mighty swing, after he dances down, for a one-handed six over wide long-on
oh thats close! McCullum kneels down and slogs and the ball misses the stumps by a whisker
thats byes, as Ponting walks down, misses, and Boucher fails to stop
fuller ball outside off and he drives it straight to cover
good grief, another leading-edged six! Kallis drops short, Ponting pulls loosely and fine leg looks on as the ball sails over his head .. they've brought the ropes in, methinks
skips down the pitch, Kallis holds back the length, and he clips to midwicket
unlucky for Kallis! Ponting eyes Bangalore's MG Road and heaves across the line, the thick edge flies down to third man
gets across and works it across the line to deep midwicket, Ponting wants two but gets sent back diving to his crease as Joshi returns a flat throw from the deep
goes for an encore but finds the fielder in the deep, on the bounce
snuff is snuff, says McCullum, who sizes up Joshi and slog-sweeps over deep midwicket for maximum
bit of flight there, dipping nicely and McCullum punches to cover
fired on leg again and thats more runs past square leg
too straight and flat and he turns it past square leg
some good turn, spins away and draws a leading-edge to cover
slants into him and he tucks it off the pads to backward square leg
tight stuff, Kallis just rolling his fingers over the cutter and Ponting pushes towards Kohli at backward point for one
slower ball comes into him and he adjusts, pushing to midwicket
gets onto the front foot and drives to point, where young Kohli fields
thats wider, McCullum flashes, and connects with hot air
walks outside his crease, misses the ball and gets struck outside the line of impact, Kallis half-appeals but the umpire is not interested
full outside off stump and McCullum drives down to mid-off
thats a good length and Ponting pushes off the front foot to point, McCullum harries down and urges the sharp single
fuller in length, driven down to Jaffer at long-off for one
another slower ball outside off and Ponting goes for the cut, inside-edging to point
strays onto the pads and McCullum turns it past midwicket
change of pace, back of a length and it foxes McCullum, who tries to work it towards mid-on but gets beaten
full this time and McCullum digs it down to long-off for one
holds back the length and Ponting defends towards point

full on leg stump, Ponting clips that trademark shot and thinks its four but out of the haze comes old Sunil Joshi, sprinting and stopping it with one foot on the ropes, a great effort and Dravid applauds
that a full toss that McCullum doesn't put away, drives into the covers
short of a length outside off, Ponting pushes forward and then back, running it down to third man for another single
pushed off the front foot past point for an easy single
slower ball, slanted across on a good length and he shoulders arms
now he heaves off the front foot but doesn't connect at all
presses forward and gets surprised by extra bounce, he does well to get his right hand off the bat handle, there's something in this track
back of a length, pushed across Ponting, who leaves it be

edged and gone! Zaheer gets the breakthrough after a poor first  over, pitching on a good length and drawing a loose drive from Ganguly, and the thick outside-edge is snapped up by Kallis at a wide lone slip, above his head .. a very sharp take
short of a length outside leg, McCullum tucks it to square leg
comes down the track, Praveen sees him coming and keeps it full and Ganguly mistimes his attempted flick
slower ball, very well bowled, McCullum flashes hard and get a thick edge past the vacant slip region, third man does the fielding
full again and he goes for a booming drive, getting an inside-edge that just evades leg stump, Praveen runs in to field
full on off stump, driven to cover, where B Akhil lets it through his legs, much to Praveen's anger ... that was an elementary error
too full on the pads and he drives past midwicket for a single
now Ganguly gets four, pulling from outside off stump over midwicket
oh he has literally smoked the pants off that one! Huge hit! McCullum makes room and drives Noffke over extra cover
full on the off stump, pushed to covers and he sprints one
swing and a miss! Comes dancing down but doesn't connect at all

and he gets a life! Ganguly tries to pull a short one but gets into a total mess, the ball goes up in the air for an eternity and lands down near fine leg, where the fielder runs in and fails to get there
a close shout, as McCullum tries to flick but misses, looks like it was marginally outside the line
oh thats hit hard! Noffke again strays down leg stump and McCullum connects with a rocket of a pull shot, very fine past square leg, for a flat six
terrible start, miles down leg stump and the wicketkeeper cant stop it
bowls it full on off stump, Ganguly gets an inside-edge to midwicket
nips in into him off a short length and he tucks it to deep backward square leg for one
doesn't time it well but gets four, pulling from outside off stump, with a thick inside-edge, and it flies past the man at midwicket ... he has such power, McCullum

steps across his stumps and heaves it to leg, mistimes if off the pads, Praveen appeals but that struck Ganguly outside the line, McCullum wants one and they run furiously ... a good throw from Jaffer just misses the stumps
short of a length and Ganguly steers it to backward point
good length ball outside off stump and he plays it to point
better ball to end an expensive over, back of a length on off stump and McCullum taps it back to Zaheer
too full on the pads and he sweetly clips that over square leg

the first six! Zaheer has McCullum in a tangle as he looks to go one way but ends up hitting it another, he walks down and tries to work it to leg but ends up with a thick outside-edge that flies over and over third man! Wow!
shot, man! Zaheer drops short and McCullum, in a flash, pulls over midwicket
bang, thats four! McCullum gets it in his area and though it comes in he gives it a nice thump over midwicket for the first boundary in IPL
shuffles around in his crease, Zaheer bowls it short and wide and McCullum misses out on the cut shot
shorter one slides down McCullum's pads and he goes for the pull, mistiming the shot past square leg and leg-byes are signalled
good bowling, nice and tight and McCullum, again cramped for room, tries to hit over the in-field but the ball follows him and he plays an ugly shot to midwicket
steps down the track and Praveen hold back the length, at a good pace, and McCullum opts to shoulder arms
too straight, McCullum drives hard to midwicket, who is sharp
thats wide, as Praveen bowls one down the legs
this one nips back in off the pitch very sharply, McCullum is cramped for room as he cuts and misses ... Ganguly walks down and has a word with him
and thats runs immediately, as Praveen strays onto the pads and Ganguly scampers a leg-bye at McCullum's call ... he wanted to get on strike!
all over, and what a mismatch! Joshi mistimes a pull to wide long-off and Kolkata win by 140 runs!
poor ball, very wide outside off stump and another freebie to the total
shorter one jags in and he keeps it out towards cover, well bowled
reaches out and clips this one wide of midwicket for more runs
slides well down leg stump, Praveen calls for the leg-bye and gets it
full on off stump and he flicks with an inside-edge onto the pads to fine leg
reaches out to cut and escapes with an inside-edge past leg stump
pitches outside leg and raps Joshi's pads, Rauf doesn't even budge
very wide outside off, carries on past the bat and wide is duly called
good shot! Too full and he drives powerfully over wide long-on for six, he's not giving up on this, is Praveen
straight again, back of a length, Praveen comes forward and pushes to cover
slips down and catches him outside the line of leg stump
dropped! By Ponting! Praveen gets a leading edge that spirals up in the air and Ponting, always struggling as he runs behind, fails to hold on
worked off the pads down to fine leg to get off the mark
cleaned up, Zaheer missing the line completely for off stump to be pegged back and Ganguly runs off in celebration and Ponting runs towards him and the two embrace ... now thats a sight, eh?
gets back and pushes this one into the covers for a single
makes room and the ball follows him, nipping away past the bat
bouncer over middle and leg, forcing him down on his haunches
short of a length, he gets up and punches wide of point for one
better stuff, straight on the stumps, pushed to mid-on this time
terrible delivery, short and very wide down leg stump and Saha does well to get a a hand on it to reduce the damage
and he's greeted with a massive six down the ground! Wow, Praveen just teed off and sent that one miles back over long-on
shuffles across and tucks this one past the man at midwicket
tidy stuff again, keeping it stump-to-stump, Praveen plods it back
this one is pushed to mid-on and Zaheer hurriedly calls Praveen across
fuller in length and Zaheer defends back to Ganguly
sharp movement, jags in and catches him in a mess, Ganguly asks the question but he says sorry boss, not that one ... but lovely seam position from Gangs
Agarkar's golden arm! Noffke clips one off his pads to deep backward square leg, from where Agarkar swoops in and fires in a good, flat throw to Saha, who does the rest
now its a good bouncer on off which Praveen ducks away from
thick outside-edge gets Praveen a boundary, as he slashes from his crease and the ball flies well wide of the lone slip to third man
thats firmly struck but its just a single out to deep cover sweeper
again Noffke chases one wide of off stump and fails to connect
stands his ground and chases it, but cannot get bat onto it
hits the deck and he gets back to play it away, another dot ball
straight again and he turns it to Kartik at midwicket this time
thats four, too straight and turned down to fine leg, Ganguly is furious
another swing, no contact, ball runs off thigh pad and Saha runs after it superbly
slants down leg stump and Saha takes it excellently, top footwork too
shorter in length and he mistimes his attempted on-drive
swings from his crease and the ball raps him, but Koertzen reckons it was missing leg stump, very close shout
back of a length outside off and he drives into the covers
they're falling like ninepins! White is beaten on the drive, inching forward to try and cream the cover off it but instead gets the thinnest of edges through to Saha, who gleefully accepts
too short and wide and he slaps it out to deep cover, another misfield there
punches off the back foot and Hussey dives to his left at cover to save runs
another wide as Agarkar sprays it around, Rauf is not impressed
too wide outside off, exaggerated movement, Asad Rauf spreads his wings
slides down leg stump, he misses out on the flick, Agarkar fields

nothing but slip catching practice! Just comes forward, then opens the face to present Ponting with one into his lap at slip... my old coach from high school used to hand us those kinds of dollies off the face of the bat
moves away past the outside-edge as he flirts from the crease
nips off that upright seam, clips White's flap just outside the line, Ganguly clears his lungs but Koertzen is unmoved

another one bites the dust, as Boucher looks towards midwicket and slogs this one up in the air down towards deep cover-point, where Kartik runs in with his eyes trained on the ball and cups it low in front of him
a touch too short and Boucher pulls from outside off, dragging it past square leg and some top fielding from Shukla saves runs, great commitment
again middle and leg, clips this one down to square leg
slips in from middle and leg, raps him on the leg, Ganguly asks the question but replays show it was missing leg
wrong line and the ball is tucked down to deep square leg
good improve from Boucher, shuffling and flicking out to deep square leg
back of a length and Boucher can only push towards point
slower ball beats Boucher's pull outside off stump, a dot ball
another wide as he pitches well outside the stumps, then shakes his head
thats called wide as he just loses concentration - maybe he saw them too!
banged in short, White pulls and gets a top-edge that drops behind Saha
good movement again as Agarkar hits the upright seam, White is foxed
pitches full, moves away, but Boucher drives well to extra cover
another top delivery, seaming in and rising to have him in a mess
slides down leg, he pulls and the ball kisses glove and runs away
drives from his crease and gets an inside-edge to midwicket, then scampers
nips in off the seam, Boucher tries to swat across the line and the ball narrowly skims over the bails
edged and taken! Dinda strikes again, getting Jaffer chasing another wide one only to hand first slip a neat catch
thats a wide well outside off stump, a needless run
and he goes next ball, just pulling the ball to mid-on for an easy catch
big hit from Kallis, who wakes up with a booming drive over extra cover, to get the local crowd on their feet
thats wide outside off, swinging away, batsman slashes but misses
shorter but too straight, turned in the air into the gap at square leg
low full toss, firmly struck into the covers, where the fielding is good
another dot ball as he fails to make contact ... Kolkata keep it tight
another atrocious shot from Jaffer, standing and chasing it with no footwork, the ball seams away and just beats the bat
walks a long way outside off and misses the shot, cant give those out
back of a length, decent carry, and Kallis leaves it be
too straight, Jaffer clips the ball down to fine leg for one
nearly a yorker outside off, he jams it down to third man, where another fumble allows the batsmen to come back for two ... looks like the dew effect
a better shot this time, more orthodox, driven towards mid-off
walks down, Dinda shapes the ball away and Jaffer hangs the bat out
backs away, Dinda bowls it too wide, some movement but wrong line
back of a length outside off, Jaffer pushes to cover where there's a fumble
some width on offer and he steers it away from his body past gully
drags it on! Kohli fails on IPL debut, playing a pull from outside off only to chop the ball onto his stumps, and doesn't young Dinda love it?
that one shoots away outside off, good carry, and beats Kohli's pull
oh thats a peach, shaving in and beating Jaffer as he drives on the up
full down leg stump, wide not called by Koertzen and the fans boo
comes forward and pushes, gets an inside-edge to fine leg
errs in line, down leg, ball clips pad and escapes for four leg-byes
short one now, skimming into Kohli, already on the front foot, and he ducks out of the way ... aggression from Ishant
and what a start for him! Full on the mark, Dravid heaves at it and misses and the ball hits the base of middle and off, handing Kolkata and excellent beginning
tries to go over the top that time but gets beaten by the bounce
back of a length outside off, he gets across and defends to point
hint of swing but thats sweetly driven to McCullum at mid-off ... so he's not keeping wickets but is on the field ... and thats a great diving effort
too straight and he clips it down to deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off stump, he gets back and plays to cover
and thats very wide outside off stump, Jaffer cant reach out
off the mark immediately, reaching out and slapping the ball to deep point
